base_dir.description: Root directory where dictionary data and index files are stored.

port.description: TCP port for the dictd server to listen on. Set to 0 to disable TCP and use only Unix socket.

socket.description: Path to the Unix domain socket (used when port=0 or for local access).

workers.description: Number of worker processes. 0 means automatically scale to number of CPU cores.

maxconn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logged messages (debug, info, notice, warn, error, etc.).

log_file.description: Path to a file for logging. If empty, logs go to stderr or syslog.

indexing.description: Whether to perform background indexing of dictionary files at startup (improves query speed).

client_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting a client.

default_dict.description: Name of the default dictionary to search if none is specified in the query.

allow.description: List of allowed client hosts/networks (CIDR or IP). If empty, all hosts are allowed.

netmask.description: CIDR netmask (e.g., 24 for /24); omit for single host

deny.description: List of denied client hosts/networks (overrides `allow`). Format matches `allow`.

netmask.description: CIDR netmask (e.g., 32 for /32); omit for single host

compression.description: Enable gzip compression of dictionary responses (reduces bandwidth).

dictionaries.description: List of dictionary sources to make available. Each entry maps a dictionary name to its data and index files.

name.description: Unique name for this dictionary (used in queries like `dict -d name`)

datafile.description: Path to the dictionary data file (e.g., `/usr/share/dictd/wn/data`)

desc.description: Optional human-readable description of the dictionary (e.g., 'Webster’s Revised Unabridged Dictionary')

mime_type.description: MIME type reported for this dictionary (e.g., `text/plain`)
